noWrittenAgreement.description: Verbal-only agreements for large projects create disputes about scope, pricing, and responsibility
mitigation: All projects above $5,000 must have a signed quote/proposal before work commences
Email acceptance of a quote is acceptable as written confirmation — print and file
Scope of work must be itemised — 'office furniture' is not a scope; specific product list with quantities is

scopeDisputeAtHandover.description: Client claims the delivered furniture is not what was agreed
mitigation: Signed quote with specific SKUs and descriptions
Delivery confirmation signed by client representative at handover

consumerLaw.reference: Australian Consumer Law (ACL) — Schedule 2 of the Competition and Consumer Act 2010
consumerLaw.implication: TCD must not mislead on product quality, warranty terms, or delivery timelines. Misleading or deceptive conduct creates liability.
consumerLaw.warranty: ACL provides automatic guarantees on goods supplied to consumers — for commercial clients (B2B), TCD's 6-year manufacturer warranty supplements ACL protections

contractorLiability.description: Installation contractor causes damage to client property or injures a person
mitigation: All contractors must hold current Public Liability Insurance — minimum $10M
Sight insurance certificate before contractor commences work
Include contractor responsibility clause in engagement letter

prohibitedConduct: Misleading or deceptive conduct (s18 ACL) — covers verbal and written representations
False representations about product quality, certification, or origin
Unconscionable conduct — particularly relevant in dealings with small businesses
australianConsumerLawKeyPoints.consumerGuarantees: For business-to-business supply, ACL consumer guarantees apply differently — check with solicitor for products supplied to businesses vs individuals
australianConsumerLawKeyPoints.disputeResolution: QCAT (Queensland Civil and Administrative Tribunal) for disputes up to $150,000 in Queensland — simpler and faster than courts
australianConsumerLawKeyPoints.note: This is general information only — seek legal advice for specific situations

minimum: Signed quote/proposal (product list, quantities, pricing, delivery timeline)
recommended_above_50k: Formal Project Agreement with scope, timeline, milestones, and change order process
